title: What if all the oil ran out overnight?
premise: Every drop of oil on Earth disappears at midnight, including fuel already in tanks.

intro.title: What if all the *oil* ran out overnight?
intro.subtitle: A HYPOTHETICAL SIMULATION

stat.label: BARRELS OF OIL THE WORLD USES EVERY DAY

beats.caption: The world burns through about a hundred million barrels of oil a day.
At midnight, it's all gone. Every engine running on fuel stalls.

banner.title: ALL FLIGHTS GROUNDED
banner.subtitle: No jet fuel left anywhere on Earth

beats.caption: Planes, ships and trucks: almost all global transport stops.
With no deliveries, supermarket shelves empty within days.
Oil isn't just fuel. It's in plastics, roads, clothes and medicine.
Farming without tractors needs far more people working the fields.
Cities would rebuild around walking, bikes, trains and electric power.

tooltip.label: PERSPECTIVE
tooltip.text: The G7 just announced a 100 million barrel emergency release. That's roughly one day of global use.

beats.caption: The air would be cleaner than it's been in over a century.
